attribution: Each row contributes its estimated hours only to its recorded category. Case/spacing aliases are merged. Asset identity is host + video key; names and SEO aliases do not split an asset. A title shared by different keys is not merged. Unknown keys are unidentified buckets, not confirmed individual assets.
limitations: Source categories include genres, placements, collections and campaigns; no genre is inferred from a title or banner.
Category hours add to the selected total. Asset counts can overlap across categories and must not be added.
Asset total hours include every category within the applied master filters; local category selection only narrows the title list.
Changes compare equal complete calendar periods with identical master/time filters; missing dates are chart gaps, not zeros.
Watch hours are request-derived estimates, not verified human watch time.
